ns2:section.sectionText: Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. Undergraduates are not allowed to enroll in the course. Students must have already obtained their bachelor's degree to enroll in this course. The course is open to non-degree students who have already obtained their bachelor's degrees, and graduate students at UIUC or other universities. However, while approved by ISBE for the bilingual and ESL endorsements, this course is not part of a UIUC bilingual graduate program, so UIUC graduate students will need to petition the transfer of the courses into their academic program. Students will be using Blackboard Collaborate (also known as Elluminate) for their synchronous sessions. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $387.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $353.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
